With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 18 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-18/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools, fill scripts, repair brief, probe and diagnosis prompts are in the same directory). Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard, list, reach, sweep and full-page 390 frames, the KEYDOWN frame on an IntervalTrack, and the BOX readings of cycle 18's lead tool (`lead-shots.ts` with `shoot-round.sh`). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand a case that scored under 80 its reviewer's findings (SendMessage to the builder's agent id resumes it), at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence.
